title: Central West Alerts 1.11.2.1 — The I broke something fix
changes: Fixed aircraft colours: ordinary aircraft are blue, fire aircraft red, rescue and medical aircraft green, police aircraft blue, and identified military aircraft purple.
Aircraft from both PiAware and adsb.lol now use the same callsign, registration and registered-owner matching rules.
Registered-owner lookups are shared, rate-limited and cached; an aircraft is shown normally while details are still unavailable.
Aircraft categories identify the aircraft, not whether it is responding to an incident.
